office_does: The county auditor runs elections and handles document recording, vehicle and vessel licensing, marriage licenses, and county payroll, accounts payable and financial reporting.
race_blurb: Acting Auditor Brandt Cappell, appointed in June to finish retired Auditor Skip Moore's term, faces retiring Wenatchee Valley Fire Chief Brian Brett, a CPA, for a short and full four-year term. Both prefer the Republican Party, and Brett led the primary about 61% to 39%.

candidates.summary: Retiring Wenatchee Valley Fire Chief with a 34-year fire-service career and a CPA credential, running for his first elected office on fiscal responsibility and stronger audit and finance functions.
highlights: 34-year fire-service career, including 8 years as Wenatchee Valley Fire Chief [S1]
Washington State CPA, former senior accountant at Cordell, Neher & Co., with a graduate certificate in governmental financial management [S1]
Says his background 'will strengthen the audit and finance functions while supporting the efficient use of taxpayer dollars' [S1]
Led the certified August primary with 12,073 votes (60.92%) [S4]

experience.basis: Has never held elected office and comes from outside the auditor's office, though with long public-agency leadership as a fire chief.

spending.basis: Frames his candidacy around fiscal responsibility, a stronger audit function and efficient use of taxpayer dollars, all in one pamphlet statement.

candidates.summary: Acting Chelan County Auditor, appointed in June 2026 after serving as the office's first chief deputy, and a former legislative aide to 12th District legislators.
highlights: Appointed acting auditor in June 2026 after Skip Moore retired; hired as the office's first chief deputy auditor in 2025 [S5][S6]
Former legislative assistant to 12th District legislators, most recently Rep. Keith Goehner [S5][S11]
Priorities include election integrity and accuracy, timely payroll and accounts payable, and protecting 'taxpayer dollars through responsible financial oversight and transparency' [S1]
Announced the restoration of recording services after the 2026 Memorial Day weekend system failure [S7]

experience.basis: Appointed incumbent and former chief deputy who runs on continuity with the outgoing auditor; his time leading the office is short.

spending.basis: Lists protecting taxpayer dollars through responsible financial oversight and transparency as a priority, in one pamphlet statement.
